title: Diff-SPORT: Diffusion-based Sensor Placement Optimization and Reconstruction of Turbulent flows in urban environments
abstract: arXiv:2506.00214v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Rapid urbanization demands efficient monitoring of turbulent wind and pollutant dispersion, yet existing reconstruction and sensor placement strategies fail under realistic sparsity constraints. Here, we introduce Diff--SPORT, a diffusion-based framework that combines a generative diffusion prior with maximum a posteriori inference and Shapley-value attribution for high-fidelity flow reconstruction and optimal sensor placement. By training a diffusion prior model once over a domain, Diff--SPORT enables non-linear optimal sensor placement and near-real-time flow reconstruction from sparse measurements orders of magnitude faster than RANS or LES simulations, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods. The framework also extends, without algorithmic modification, to experimental passive scalar concentration dataset, a direct proxy for pollutant dispersion, measured in a 1:2400 scale water-flume model of the Beijing Haidia

translated_title: Diff-SPORT：基于扩散模型的城市环境湍流传感器布置优化与流场重构
translated_abstract: 快速城市化要求对湍流风场和污染物扩散进行高效监测，然而现有的流场重构和传感器布置策略在现实稀疏性约束下表现不佳。本文提出了Diff-SPORT，一个基于扩散模型的框架，它将生成式扩散先验与最大后验（MAP）推断和Shapley值归因相结合，用于高保真流场重构和最优传感器布置。通过在一个计算域上仅训练一次扩散先验模型，Diff-SPORT即可实现非线性最优传感器布置，并能从稀疏测量数据中进行近实时流场重构，其速度比RANS或LES模拟快几个数量级，且性能始终优于当前最先进的方法。该框架无需任何算法修改即可扩展到实验测量的被动标量浓度数据集（污染物扩散的直接代理指标），该数据集来自1:2400比例的北京海淀水槽模型实验。
tldr: 本文提出基于扩散模型的Diff-SPORT框架，通过结合扩散先验、最大后验推断与Shapley值归因，实现了城市湍流的近实时高保真重构与最优传感器布置，速度比传统RANS/LES模拟快几个数量级。
en_tdlr: Diff-SPORT is a diffusion-based framework that combines generative diffusion priors with MAP inference and Shapley-value attribution to enable near-real-time high-fidelity turbulent flow reconstruction and optimal sensor placement in urban environments, orders of magnitude faster than RANS/LES simulations.
